caption: The drawing depicts two elongated, dark-colored, fur-like objects laid horizontally and parallel to each other on a light background. Both objects appear mainly black or very dark brown, with textured shading to suggest the uneven surface of fur. The object at the top has a rectangular, gold or brass-colored buckle attached to its right end, with a thick cuff-like section there; the left end tapers and is closed with two small gold loops holding a cord tied in a knot. The object at the bottom is similar in color and shape, with a rounded right end that is thicker and folded over, secured by a light-colored cord tied in a figure eight shape, and a small metallic hook or clasp located near the middle right edge. The bottom object also has a gold cord tied at its left end, similar to the top object. There are small printed numbers and letters, "A 3580 - 121", at the bottom left corner, and the name "Lyman Young" written at the bottom right. The overall composition is neat, with both objects occupying the majority of the image and arranged against the plain, off-white background.
title: Ankle Band or Garters
